subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------RT.ALGN.
description: Diagram in R(AS)CM(I)-3 (Reality Aspect of Creative Music, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that jazz journalism's two basic positions — '(1) bebop is no different from what already took place in western art music — which is to say, classical commentary is valid because this form is understood, and (2) the solidification of this form (bebop) implies a profound separation from the composite continuum of black creative music' — both positions are wrong, and were united only in their being wrong. (C)LANG-DY (language dynamics) is crossed with RT-ALGN (reality alignment): the question is what language-dynamics produces when crossed with reality-alignment in a culture where the defining/critical community itself routes through linguistic confusion. MT-INFO-DB (multi-informational degree basis) feeds the upper section. PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and (P)INTR (the point of activation of interpretation) feed from the left. (R)DIFF (the reality of differentiation, *probably* re-dif redefinitions in the glossary) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) form lower constituting nodes. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the central convergence with PART (participation) below. RE-ST (restructuralism) and CUL-AF-B (culture affinity basis) are right-side outputs. Structural argument: language-dynamics crossed with reality-alignment requires multi-informational-degree-basis as upstream, and the point-of-activation prefix on interpretation marks Braxton's structural claim that real interpretation must be activated — passive critical commentary doesn't count. Restructuralism is reached only via the time-continuum convergence.
